goal.name: Backend Development
goal.video_language_note: English: topic videos from Traversy Media, Web Dev Simplified, Fireship, TechWorld with Nana, freeCodeCamp and others. Hindi: Chai aur Code's backend course and Thapa Technical.
career_outcomes: Design and build REST APIs with Node.js, Express and TypeScript
Model data in PostgreSQL and use an ORM safely
Implement secure authentication and follow OWASP guidance
Test, containerise, deploy and document services with CI/CD
Explain basic system-design trade-offs in interviews
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Video minutes are real YouTube durations with the +15% rule applied (see goal.last_link_check). Mocks and the revision allowance remain planning figures.

goal.prerequisite_note: Basic JavaScript helps (FreeMentor Frontend roadmap, Phase 3). The FreeMentor SQL roadmap goes deeper on databases.
